Reviewed fixed binding metadata, partial-view store updates, RHS-first ordering, runtime writable/replaceable guards, frame GC and forward Destructor embedding. Explicitly retained the demonstrated older-ID invariant failure and missing Assignment soundness/reflection as future proof obligations. Existing claims and selected sources were compared byte-for-byte with prior reviewed packets; new AGENTS scope and SUMMARY insertion were inspected. This is differential author review for unchanged units, not an independent review. CLI workers only partition immutable evidence preparation/recording; no subagents were used.
rationale: Links variable descriptions, storage, structural WF, per-reference realization and table/type WF. Pending pairs are introduced immediately beside the relation that accounts for them. Assignment insertion shifts subsequent chapter positions but leaves existing authored passages, targets, relative concept order and prior classifications unchanged. Required non-audit inputs were compared exactly, except the reviewed SUMMARY and AGENTS updates.
limitations: Author editorial self-review. Extraction and byte ranges do not establish clarity by themselves. Earlier unchanged passages retain the prior review after exact-input comparison. Future notes remain nonnormative.
